description:
Terminate then relaunch an app on iOS, Android, or Vega.
Use when you need a clean in-memory state without a full reinstall. The relaunch also refreshes the native-devtools injection (iOS and Apple TV).
Returns { restarted, bundleId, networkCapture? }. networkCapture (Android) says whether native network capture followed the launch. Fails if the app is not installed, on a local iOS simulator if terminating it does not finish within 15s, or on a remote simulator if terminating it fails for a reason other than the app not running.

activity.description: Android-only: relaunch a non-launcher Activity (e.g. `.SettingsActivity` or `com.example/com.example.SettingsActivity`). If omitted, the app's default launcher activity is used.

bundleId.description: App identifier. iOS: bundle id. Android: package name. Vega: interactive component app id.

launchArgs.description: Apple simulators and physical iPhones: arguments passed to the app process at launch, e.g. `["-FeatureFlag", "YES"]` to override UserDefaults.

udid.description: Target device id from `list-devices` (iOS UDID or Android serial).

name: restart-app
